# Test fixture attribution

Generated by `mise run fixtures` (`fixtures/src/main.rs`). Don't edit by hand.

Each `<name>.wav` is an excerpt of a dataset recording, and `<name>.f0.csv`
is its reference pitch track (`time_s,f0_hz`, 0 = unvoiced), with times
relative to the excerpt's start.

## Vocadito

- Source: <https://zenodo.org/records/5578807> (`vocadito.zip`, md5 `dea40fd18f14d899643c4ba221b33a46`)
- Licence: CC BY 4.0
- Citation: R. M. Bittner, K. Pasalo, J. J. Bosch, G. Meseguer-Brocal and D. Rubinstein, "vocadito: A dataset of solo vocals with f0, note, and lyric annotations", 2021. arXiv:2110.05580.
- Reference: `Annotations/F0/vocadito_N_f0.csv`.

| Fixture | Source | Excerpt | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vocadito_7_vibrato` | `vocadito_7.wav` | 10 s + 8 s | Held notes with clear vibrato (about ±50 cents at 5–7 Hz, e.g. at 7.4 s); 214–469 Hz |
| `vocadito_35_low` | `vocadito_35.wav` | 1 s + 8 s | Track 35, joint-lowest `average_pitch` (track 28 dips below 80 Hz); 84–186 Hz |

## NSynth

- Source: <https://magenta.tensorflow.org/datasets/nsynth> (`nsynth-test.jsonwav.tar.gz`, SHA-256 `0f9ba5d62beba9ec4612f918d19f5e87a681822f1c566124f05fe8b27a51934c`)

- Reference: synthesised at the note's MIDI pitch (A4 = 440 Hz), every 10 ms from 0.2 s to 2.8 s (the sustained part).
